title: [Model][Bugfix] Add glm-4v Model and Fix bnb Quantization Issue
bodyExcerpt:
## Add glm-4v Model and Fix bnb Quantization Issue FIX #6097 FIX #5417 **Description**: This PR integrates the glm-4v model into the vLLM project and resolves an issue related to bnb quantization for this model. The previous quantization approach caused inaccuracies, particularly affecting the glm-4v model's performance, which has now been corrected. This PR references and follows the structure similar to (https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/5358). **Key Changes**: Implemented support for the glm-4v model. Corrected the bnb quantization issue that was affecting the glm-4v model's functionality. **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/alexw994/vllm/commits/v0.5.4.extras.glm-4v **Usage** : [Colab Notebook](https://colab.research.google.com/drive/1jpCM0H3thZjN1XqcnpHm3S5g2Z9Pz89k?usp=sharing) ---
